newsitem.title: GERMANY: Soy oil fall leads world oils/fats stocks drawdown.
newsitem.headline: Soy oil fall leads world oils/fats stocks drawdown.

text.p: Global oils and fats stocks will be down to 9.65 million tonnes by the end of September, 1.3 million tonnes below year-earlier levels and led by soy oil, the independent Oil World newsletter predicted.
January stocks were 11.1 million tonnes, falling to 10.05 million in April. The falls applied mostly to soy oil, palm oil, rape oil and sunflower oil, in that order.
Stocks were falling because tight oilseed supplies and lower crushings in the Americas corresponded with strong demand, especially in China and India, Oil World said.
End-September stocks of soy oil, the leading commodity, were put at 2.34 million tonnes (2.74 million a year earlier).
